title: Lynx 样式
html:
Lynx 样式

核心概念

Lynx 的样式系统基于 CSS 子集实现，以 Flexbox 布局为核心，支持常用的 CSS 属性、动画系统、主题切换和响应式设计。与 Web CSS 的最大区别在于：Lynx 默认所有元素都是 display: flex，不支持浮动（float）和定位（position: relative/absolute）的传统 Web 布局模式。理解 Lynx 样式系统的能力边界和最佳实践，是构建高质量跨平台 UI 的基础。

样式系统架构

graph TB
    subgraph CSS解析
        A[CSS 文件] --> B[Tokenizer 词法分析]
        B --> C[Parser 语法分析]
        C --> D[Style Rules 集合]
    end

    subgraph 样式计算
        D --> E[选择器匹配]
        E --> F[属性继承]
        F --> G[优先级计算]
        G --> H[最终计算样式]
    end

    subgraph 布局引擎
        H --> I[Yoga Layout]
        I --> J[Flexbox 计算]
        J --> K[绝对位置 & 尺寸]
    end

CSS 子集支持

支持的属性分类

类别 支持的属性 不支持
布局 display, flex, flex-direction, justify-content, align-items, align-self, flex-wrap, gap float, grid, table, inline-block
尺寸 width, height, min/max-width/height, aspect-ratio, padding, margin calc() 有限支持
文本 font-size, font-weight, color, line-height, text-align, text-overflow word-spacing, letter-spacing(部分)
背景 background-color, background-image, background-size, background-position background-blend-mode
边框 border, border-radius, border-color, border-width border-image
变换 transform (translate, scale, rotate), opacity perspective (部分)
动画 transition, animation, @keyframes CSS Variables 有限
定位 position (absolute/relative), top/left/right/bottom, z-index position: sticky/fixed
溢出 overflow: hidden/scroll/visible overflow-x/y 独立控制

Flex 布局深入

Lynx 的布局引擎基于 Yoga（Facebook 开源的跨平台 Flexbox 实现），所有元素默认 display: flex。

主轴与交叉轴布局

.row-layout {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 16px;
}

.col-layout {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  align-items: stretch;
}

.center-layout {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

.wrap-layout {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
}

Flex 属性详解

function FlexDemo() {
  return (
    <view className="flex-container">
      <view className="item fixed">
        <text>固定宽度</text>
      </view>
      <view className="item grow">
        <text>自动填充剩余空间</text>
      </view>
      <view className="item shrink">
        <text>允许收缩</text>
      </view>
    </view>
  );
}
.flex-container {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  width: 100%;
  height: 60px;
}

.item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 0 12px;
}

.fixed {
  flex: 0 0 100px;
  background-color: #e6f7ff;
}

.grow {
  flex: 1 0 0;
  background-color: #f6ffed;
}

.shrink {
  flex: 0 1 150px;
  background-color: #fff7e6;
}

常用布局模式

.card-layout {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  padding: 12px;
  background-color: #ffffff;
  border-radius: 8px;
}

.card-avatar {
  flex: 0 0 48px;
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: 24px;
}

.card-content {
  flex: 1;
  margin-left: 12px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
}

.card-action {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}

.waterfall-item {
  width: 50%;
  padding: 4px;
}

.grid-3col {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.grid-3col-item {
  width: 33.33%;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  padding: 4px;
}

.sticky-bottom {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  padding: 16px;
  background-color: #ffffff;
}

动画系统

Lynx 支持 CSS Transition 和 Keyframe Animation 两种动画方式，动画在原生线程执行，不受 JS 线程阻塞影响。

Transition 过渡动画

import { useState } from '@lynx-js/react';

function TransitionDemo() {
  const [active, setActive] = useState(false);

  return (
    <view className="demo-container">
      <view className={`animated-box ${active ? 'active' : ''}`} bindtap={() => setActive(!active)}>
        <text className="box-text">点击动画</text>
      </view>

      <view className="button-row">
        <view className={`tab-button ${active ? 'selected' : ''}`} bindtap={() => setActive(true)}>
          <text className="tab-text">选中</text>
          <view className={`tab-indicator ${active ? 'tab-active' : ''}`} />
        </view>
      </view>
    </view>
  );
}
.animated-box {
  width: 120px;
  height: 120px;
  background-color: #1890ff;
  border-radius: 8px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out;
  transform: scale(1);
  opacity: 1;
}

.animated-box.active {
  background-color: #52c41a;
  border-radius: 60px;
  transform: scale(1.1);
}

.tab-indicator {
  width: 0;
  height: 3px;
  background-color: #1890ff;
  border-radius: 1.5px;
  transition: width 0.25s ease-out;
  margin-top: 4px;
}

.tab-active {
  width: 100%;
}

Keyframe 动画

@keyframes fadeInUp {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(20px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

@keyframes pulse {
  0% {
    transform: scale(1);
    opacity: 1;
  }
  50% {
    transform: scale(1.05);
    opacity: 0.8;
  }
  100% {
    transform: scale(1);
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

@keyframes shimmer {
  0% {
    background-position: -200px 0;
  }
  100% {
    background-position: 200px 0;
  }
}

@keyframes rotate {
  from {
    transform: rotate(0deg);
  }
  to {
    transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
}

.enter-animation {
  animation: fadeInUp 0.4s ease-out forwards;
}

.pulse-animation {
  animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.loading-skeleton {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f0f0f0 25%, #e0e0e0 50%, #f0f0f0 75%);
  background-size: 400px 100%;
  animation: shimmer 1.5s infinite linear;
}

.spinner {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  border: 3px solid #e5e5e5;
  border-top: 3px solid #1890ff;
  border-radius: 12px;
  animation: rotate 0.8s linear infinite;
}

交错动画

function StaggeredList({ items }: { items: ListItem[] }) {
  return (
    <view className="staggered-list">
      {items.map((item, index) => (
        <view key={item.id} className="staggered-item" style={{ animationDelay: `${index * 80}ms` }}>
          <text className="item-title">{item.title}</text>
        </view>
      ))}
    </view>
  );
}
.staggered-item {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateX(-20px);
  animation: slideInRight 0.3s ease-out forwards;
}

@keyframes slideInRight {
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateX(0);
  }
}

主题切换

import { createContext, useContext, useState, useCallback } from '@lynx-js/react';

type Theme = 'light' | 'dark';

const ThemeContext = createContext<{
  theme: Theme;
  colors: ThemeColors;
  toggle: () => void;
}>({
  theme: 'light',
  colors: lightColors,
  toggle: () => {},
});

const lightColors = {
  background: '#ffffff',
  surface: '#f5f5f5',
  text: '#1a1a1a',
  textSecondary: '#666666',
  primary: '#1890ff',
  border: '#e5e5e5',
  card: '#ffffff',
};

const darkColors = {
  background: '#1a1a1a',
  surface: '#2d2d2d',
  text: '#ffffff',
  textSecondary: '#a0a0a0',
  primary: '#40a9ff',
  border: '#404040',
  card: '#2d2d2d',
};

type ThemeColors = typeof lightColors;

function ThemeProvider({ children }: { children: any }) {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState<Theme>('light');

  const toggle = useCallback(() => {
    setTheme((prev) => (prev === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light'));
  }, []);

  const colors = theme === 'light' ? lightColors : darkColors;

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, colors, toggle }}>
      <view style={{ backgroundColor: colors.background, flex: 1 }}>{children}</view>
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
}

function ThemedCard({ title, content }: { title: string; content: string }) {
  const { colors } = useContext(ThemeContext);

  return (
    <view
      style={{
        backgroundColor: colors.card,
        borderRadius: 12,
        padding: 16,
        borderWidth: 1,
        borderColor: colors.border,
      }}
    >
      <text style={{ color: colors.text, fontSize: 16, fontWeight: '600' }}>{title}</text>
      <text style={{ color: colors.textSecondary, fontSize: 14, marginTop: 8 }}>{content}</text>
    </view>
  );
}

响应式设计

Lynx 中的响应式设计需要通过 JS 逻辑获取屏幕尺寸，然后动态调整样式。

import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from '@lynx-js/react';

type ScreenSize = 'small' | 'medium' | 'large';

function useScreenSize(): ScreenSize {
  const [width, setWidth] = useState(375);

  useEffect(() => {
    const info = lynx.getSystemInfoSync();
    setWidth(info.screenWidth);
  }, []);

  if (width < 375) return 'small';
  if (width < 768) return 'medium';
  return 'large';
}

function ResponsiveGrid({ items }: { items: GridItem[] }) {
  const screenSize = useScreenSize();

  const columns = useMemo(() => {
    switch (screenSize) {
      case 'small':
        return 2;
      case 'medium':
        return 3;
      case 'large':
        return 4;
    }
  }, [screenSize]);

  const itemWidth = `${100 / columns}%`;

  return (
    <view className="responsive-grid">
      {items.map((item) => (
        <view key={item.id} style={{ width: itemWidth, padding: 4 }}>
          <view className="grid-item">
            <image src={item.image} className="grid-image" mode="aspectFill" />
            <text className="grid-title">{item.title}</text>
          </view>
        </view>
      ))}
    </view>
  );
}
.responsive-grid {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.grid-item {
  border-radius: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background-color: #ffffff;
}

.grid-image {
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
}

.grid-title {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #333333;
  padding: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

样式性能优化

优化策略 做法 避免
减少嵌套 保持 view 嵌套不超过 10 层 无意义的 view 包裹
避免频繁样式计算 使用 className 而非 inline style 在循环中计算 style 对象
动画优化 只动画 transform 和 opacity 动画 width/height/padding
图片优化 指定固定尺寸 让图片自适应撑开容器
列表优化 给 cell 指定固定高度 动态高度频繁变化 
.optimized-animation {
  transition:
    transform 0.3s ease-out,
    opacity 0.3s ease-out;
}

.bad-animation {
  transition:
    width 0.3s,
    height 0.3s,
    padding 0.3s;
}

小结

mindmap
  root((Lynx 样式系统))
    布局
      Flexbox 默认
      Yoga 引擎
      CSS 子集
    动画
      Transition
      Keyframe
      原生线程执行
    主题
      Context 注入
      动态 style
      light/dark
    性能
      GPU 加速属性
      避免重排
      列表虚拟化

Lynx 样式系统以 CSS 子集 + Flexbox 为核心，在保持 Web 开发者熟悉度的同时，针对移动端做了合理取舍。动画系统在原生线程执行保证了流畅度，主题系统通过 Context + 动态 style 实现，响应式设计依赖 JS 屏幕尺寸检测。掌握 Flex 布局的各种模式和动画性能优化策略是写出高质量 Lynx UI 的关键。

核心要点回顾：

  • Lynx 默认所有元素 display: flex，布局引擎基于 Yoga
  • 支持 CSS 属性子集，不支持 float、grid、table 等传统 Web 布局
  • Transition 和 Keyframe Animation 在原生线程执行，不受 JS 阻塞
  • 只动画 transform 和 opacity 以保证性能（GPU 加速属性）
  • 主题切换通过 Context + 动态 style 实现，支持 light/dark 模式
  • 响应式设计需要通过 JS 获取屏幕尺寸动态调整布局
